# `opense4.ui`

Interface extensions (docs/sdk/interface.md): the values a mod's ui/*.toml files show that its own Python works out.

A mod's ui/*.py files register functions with `ui.value`:

```python
from opense4 import ui

@ui.value("charge")
def charge(view, ship):
    return ship.supply * 100 // max(1, ship.design.figures.supply)
```

Each gets `view`, the player's own view of the game (docs/sdk/view.md, read from the engine a part at a time: what the player knows, never more), and the thing the value is shown for: a Vehicle, Fleet, SpaceObject (a planet), Colony, System, Empire or Design. It answers a whole number, text, True or False, None (no value: shown as "-"), or a list of these (shown joined with ", ").

Interface code runs on the player's own computer, in the sandbox, with a small budget per value. It reads the game and never changes it: there are no effects and no commands here (a panel's button gives a mod order as a command, docs/sdk/rules.md "Orders"). Values are worked out again only when the game changes (a command given, a new turn), never every frame; nothing lasts in module globals from one batch of values to the next.

Source: [python/opense4/ui.py](../../../python/opense4/ui.py). Index: [the API reference](README.md).

Contents: [`Registration`](#registration), [`value`](#value), [`registrations`](#registrations), [`find`](#find), [`clear`](#clear), [`PlayerView`](#playerview), [`dispatch`](#dispatch).

## `Registration`

```python
Registration(mod: str, kind: str, name: str, fn: Callable[..., Any])
```

One registered function: its mod, kind ("value") and name.

## `value`

```python
value(name: str) -> Callable[[Callable[..., Any]], Callable[..., Any]]
```

Registers the decorated function as the computed value `name` (`value = "name"` in a row of a [[panel]], a [[column]] or an [[empire_page.column]]): `f(view, thing)`.

## `registrations`

```python
registrations(mod: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Registration]
```

Everything registered (by one mod, or all), in order.

## `find`

```python
find(mod: str, name: str) -> Optional[Callable[..., Any]]
```

The function a mod registered as the value `name`, or None.

## `clear`

```python
clear() -> None
```

Forgets every registration (for tests).

## `PlayerView`

```python
PlayerView(backend: Optional[_Backend] = None, empire: Optional[int] = None)
```

Extends `_View`.

The player's own view of the game (opense4.view.View), read from the engine a part at a time; a lookup by id (`view.vehicle(id)`) reads that thing only.

### `PlayerView.resolve`

```python
resolve(kind: str, id: Optional[int]) -> Any
```

### `PlayerView.ability`

```python
ability(thing: Any, name: str, kind: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[int]
```

The value of an ability (a declared one or the game's own) on one of the player's vehicles, designs or colonies, or on a system; None when it does not carry it.

## `dispatch`

```python
dispatch(request: Dict[str, Any], backend: Any = None) -> Dict[str, Any]
```

The engine's entry point: `load` imports the mods' ui/ modules, `value` works out one value.
